helper-for-morphe.description:
Helper for Morphe is a standalone Android helper app for finding and returning original APK files requested by Morphe Manager. It receives a package/version request through an Android intent, resolves a matching file from a supported APK source, downloads it when a direct download is available, and returns a readable content:// URI back to the caller.

This project is independent from the APK source websites listed below. Source availability, package versions, download formats, and region/device access can change at any time.
